description: Install Playwright and Chromium in the audit directory, verify the environment can launch a headless browser and reach adaptly.co.uk
steps: npx playwright install chromium (installs the Chromium browser binary)
Create a minimal smoke-test script that launches Chromium, navigates to https://adaptly.co.uk/login, confirms the page loads (title or body contains relevant text), then closes the browser
Run the smoke test and confirm it exits cleanly
acceptance_criteria: playwright and chromium are installed and importable
A headless Chromium instance can navigate to adaptly.co.uk without error
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/send-assistant/audit && node -e "import('playwright').then(p => p.chromium.launch({headless:true}).then(b => b.close().then(() => console.log('OK'))))" and see 'OK'
